title: fix: Auto-derive userFilters from objectDef when not explicitly configured
body:
`userFilters` (Airtable-style field-level filter bar) never rendered because it was gated on `schema.userFilters` being explicitly set — which no default scenario provides. ### Changes - **Auto-derivation in `ListView.tsx`**: New `resolvedUserFilters` memo scans `objectDef.fields` for `select`, `multi-select`, and `boolean` types and synthesizes a `dropdown`-mode config when no explicit `schema.userFilters` is provided - **Empty state + entry point in `UserFilters.tsx`**: Dropdown mode now shows a `SlidersHorizontal` icon prefix, a "No filter fields" placeholder when empty, and an "Add filter" button as the configuration entry point - **Tests**: Coverage for auto-derivation from objectDef, explicit config passthrough, empty/no-filterable-fields cases, and Add filter button presence ### How it works ```tsx // Before: only renders if schema author explicitly sets userFilters {schema.userFilters && } // After: auto-derives from objectDef when not configured const resolvedUserFilters = useMemo(() => { if (schema.userFilters) return schema.userFilters; if (!objectDef?.fields) return undefined; const FILTERABLE_FIELD_TYPES = new Set(['select', 'multi-select', 'boolean']); // ... derive dropdown config from matching fields return { element: 'dropdown', fields: derivedFields }; }, [schema.userFilters, objectDef]); {resolvedUserFilters && } ``` Explicit `schema.userFilters` config is respected as-is — auto-derivation only kicks in as a fallback.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > [回归缺陷] userFilters 字段级过滤未渲染到工具栏，缺少过滤系统配置入口（验收标准未通过） > ### ⚠️ Bug: userFilters 区块未显示，缺少过滤系统入口，验收标准不通过 > > 见实际效果截图： > > > #### 问题描述 > - "Airtable 风格字段级过滤器"（Dropdown/Tabs/Toggle）并未出现在列表视图顶部工具栏左侧 > - 无"新建过滤器"/"过滤系统配置"入口，也没有 visible filter badge/button > - 没有任何地方能实际配置/使用 userFilters > > #### 预期行为 > - 顶部工具栏左上应有 userFilters 区块，支持 dropdown/tabs/toggle 三种模式（参考 objectstack-ai/objectui#637 需求与设计稿） > - 可视化增删过滤字段或打开过滤系统面板（Airtable 风格） > > #### 实际行为 > - 工具栏左侧仍只显示传统的 Hide fields/Filter/Group/Sort 等按钮，无 userFilters 相关内容 > - 没有"➕ 新建过滤器"或配置入口 > > #### 复现步骤 > 1. 访问 demo 或本地最新部署环境，进入包含 ListView 的页面 > 2. 检查顶部工具栏左上，userFilters 未出现 > > #### 影响 > - 重大可用性问题，用户无法按字段快速过滤，需求验收无法通过 > > --- > > ## 【需补救方案】 > > - [ ] 检查 ObjectView 层是否自动传入/推导 userFilters 给 ListView > - [ ] 为默认无配置场景，自动推导 select/multi-select/boolean 字段生成 userFilters schema > - [ ] ListView 顶部左侧始终渲染 userFilters 区块，若无配置则显示"暂无过滤字段"提示 > - [ ] 增加"➕ 新建过滤器"或"配置过滤系统"入口 > - [ ] 开发 Console 后台字段过滤配置 UI（Airtable 风格的右栏） > - [ ] 完善端到端/单元测试，覆盖页面展示与用户操作路径 > > --- > > 相关 issue: objectstack-ai/objectui#637 > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
